Chapter 16

Persistent VolumesPersistentVolume

Persistent volumes are a specific category of the wider concept of volumes with the capability of persisting data beyond a Pod lifecycle. The mechanics for persistent volumes are slightly more complex. The persistent volume is the resource that actually persists the data to an underlying physical storage.

PersistentVolume 是更广泛的 volume 概念中的一个特定类别，具备在 Pod 生命周期之外持久保留数据的能力。PersistentVolume 的机制略复杂一些。PersistentVolume 才是真正把数据持久化到底层物理存储的资源。

The persistent volume claim represents the connecting resource between a Pod and a persistent volume responsible for requesting the storage.

PersistentVolumeClaim 是 Pod 与 PersistentVolume 之间的连接资源，负责请求存储。

Finally, the Pod needs to claim the persistent volume and mount it to a directory path available to the containers running inside of the Pod.

最后，Pod 需要声明该 PersistentVolume，并把它挂载到 Pod 内容器可访问的某个目录路径。

Working with Persistent Volumes使用 PersistentVolume

Data stored on volumes outlive a container restart. In many applications, the data lives far beyond the lifecycles of the applications, container, Pod, nodes, and even the clusters themselves. Data persistence ensures the lifecycles of the data are decoupled from the lifecycles of the cluster resources. A typical example would be data persisted by a database. That’s the responsibility of a persistent volume. Kubernetes models persist data with the help of two primitives: the PersistentVolume and the PersistentVolumeClaim.

存储在 volume 上的数据在容器重启后仍然存在。在很多应用中，数据的寿命远远超过应用、容器、Pod、节点，甚至集群本身的生命周期。数据持久化确保数据的生命周期与集群资源的生命周期解耦。一个典型例子就是数据库持久化的数据。这正是 PersistentVolume 的职责。Kubernetes 借助两个原语来建模持久化数据：PersistentVolume 和 PersistentVolumeClaim。

The PersistentVolume is the primitive representing a piece of storage in a Kubernetes cluster. It is completely decoupled from the Pod and therefore has its own lifecycle. The object captures the source of the storage (e.g., storage made available by a cloud provider). A PersistentVolume is either provided by a Kubernetes administrator or assigned dynamically by mapping to a storage class.

PersistentVolume 是代表 Kubernetes 集群中一块存储的原语。它与 Pod 完全解耦，因此有自己独立的生命周期。该对象记录了存储的来源（例如由云厂商提供的存储）。PersistentVolume 要么由 Kubernetes 管理员提供，要么通过映射到 StorageClass 动态分配。

The PersistentVolumeClaim requests the resources of a PersistentVolume—for example, the size of the storage and the access type. In the Pod, you will use the type persistentVolumeClaim to mount the abstracted PersistentVolume by using the PersistentVolumeClaim.

PersistentVolumeClaim 请求 PersistentVolume 的资源——例如存储大小和访问类型。在 Pod 中，你会使用 persistentVolumeClaim 类型，通过 PersistentVolumeClaim 来挂载被抽象出来的 PersistentVolume。

Volume TypesVolume 类型

Kubernetes supports several types of persistent volumes to accommodate different storage backends and use cases. Each type has its own characteristics and is suitable for specific scenarios. Table 16-1 lists the most commonly used persistent volume types that are not deprecated.

Kubernetes 支持多种 PersistentVolume 类型，以适配不同的存储后端和用例。每种类型都有自己的特性，适用于特定场景。表 16-1 列出了最常用且未被弃用的 PersistentVolume 类型。

TypeDescription
hostPathMounts a file or directory from the host node’s filesystem into the Pod. Useful for development and testing but not recommended for production multi-node clusters, as it ties the Pod to a specific node.
hostPath把宿主机节点文件系统中的文件或目录挂载到 Pod。对开发和测试有用，但不建议在生产多节点集群中使用，因为它把 Pod 绑定到了特定节点。
localRepresents a mounted local storage device such as a disk, partition, or directory. Provides better performance than remote storage but requires node affinity to ensure Pods are scheduled on the correct node.
local代表一个已挂载的本地存储设备，例如磁盘、分区或目录。性能优于远程存储，但需要节点亲和性来确保 Pod 被调度到正确的节点。
— PDF p.226 —
TypeDescription
nfsAllows multiple Pods to share the same Network File System (NFS) mount. Supports ReadWriteMany access mode and is useful for sharing data between Pods across nodes.
nfs允许多个 Pod 共享同一个 Network File System（NFS）挂载。支持 ReadWriteMany 访问模式，适合在跨节点的 Pod 之间共享数据。
csiContainer Storage Interface (CSI) driver that provides a standardized way to expose storage systems to containerized workloads. Most modern storage solutions use CSI drivers.
csiContainer Storage Interface（CSI）驱动，提供一种把存储系统暴露给容器化工作负载的标准化方式。大多数现代存储方案都使用 CSI 驱动。
fcFibre Channel (FC) volume that allows existing FC storage to be attached to Pods. Requires FC hardware and proper configuration on nodes.
fcFibre Channel（FC）volume，允许把已有的 FC 存储挂载到 Pod。需要 FC 硬件并在节点上做正确配置。
iscsiInternet Small Computer Systems Interface (iSCSI) volume that allows existing iSCSI storage to be mounted to Pods. Provides block-level storage over IP networks.
iscsiInternet Small Computer Systems Interface（iSCSI）volume，允许把已有的 iSCSI 存储挂载到 Pod。通过 IP 网络提供块级存储。

The choice of volume type depends on your infrastructure, performance requirements, and whether you need the storage to be shared across multiple Pods or nodes. For cloud environments, CSI drivers are typically provided by cloud providers (like AWS EBS CSI driver, GCE Persistent Disk CSI driver, or Azure Disk CSI driver) to integrate with their native storage services.

volume 类型的选择取决于你的基础设施、性能需求，以及是否需要在多个 Pod 或节点之间共享存储。在云环境中，CSI 驱动通常由云厂商提供（例如 AWS EBS CSI 驱动、GCE Persistent Disk CSI 驱动或 Azure Disk CSI 驱动），用于与它们的原生存储服务集成。

Static Versus Dynamic Provisioning静态供应与动态供应

A PersistentVolume can be created statically or dynamically. If you go with the static approach, then you first need to create a storage device and then reference it by explicitly creating an object of kind PersistentVolume. The dynamic approach doesn’t require you to create a PersistentVolume object. It will be automatically created from the PersistentVolumeClaim by setting a storage class name using the attribute spec.storageClassName.

PersistentVolume 可以静态创建，也可以动态创建。如果采用静态方式，你需要先创建一个存储设备，然后显式创建一个 kind 为 PersistentVolume 的对象来引用它。动态方式不需要你创建 PersistentVolume 对象：只要在 PersistentVolumeClaim 中通过 spec.storageClassName 属性设置 StorageClass 名称，PersistentVolume 就会自动创建。

A storage class is an abstraction concept that defines a class of storage device (e.g., storage with slow or fast performance) used for different application types. It’s the job of a Kubernetes administrator to set up storage classes. For a deeper discussion on storage classes, see “Storage Classes” on page 213. For now, we’ll focus on the static provisioning of PersistentVolumes.

StorageClass 是一个抽象概念，定义了一类存储设备（例如性能慢或性能快的存储），用于不同类型的应用。设置 StorageClass 是 Kubernetes 管理员的工作。关于 StorageClass 的更深入讨论见第 213 页“Storage Classes”。现在我们先聚焦 PersistentVolume 的静态供应。

Creating PersistentVolumes创建 PersistentVolume

When you create a PersistentVolume object yourself, we refer to the approach as static provisioning. A PersistentVolume can be created only by using the manifest-first approach. At this time, kubectl doesn’t allow the creation of a PersistentVolume using the create command. Every PersistentVolume needs to define the storage capacity using spec.capacity and an access mode set via spec.accessModes. See “Configuration Options for a PersistentVolume” on page 206 for more information on the configuration options available to a PersistentVolume.

当你自己创建 PersistentVolume 对象时，我们把这种方式称为静态供应。PersistentVolume 只能通过 manifest-first 的方式创建。目前 kubectl 不允许使用 create 命令创建 PersistentVolume。每个 PersistentVolume 都需要通过 spec.capacity 定义存储容量，并通过 spec.accessModes 设置访问模式。关于 PersistentVolume 可用的配置选项，见第 206 页“Configuration Options for a PersistentVolume”。

Example 16-1 creates a PersistentVolume named db-pv with a storage capacity of 1 Gi and read/write access by a single node. The attribute hostPath mounts the directory /data/db from the host node’s filesystem. We’ll store the YAML manifest in the file db-pv.yaml.

例 16-1 创建了一个名为 db-pv 的 PersistentVolume，存储容量为 1 Gi，单节点读写访问。hostPath 属性挂载宿主机节点文件系统中的目录 /data/db。我们把该 YAML 清单保存到文件 db-pv.yaml。

— PDF p.227 —

Example 16-1. YAML manifest defining a PersistentVolume

例 16-1. 定义 PersistentVolume 的 YAML 清单

apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolume
metadata:
  name: db-pv
spec:
  capacity:
    storage: 1Gi
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  hostPath:
    path: /data/db
  • The storage capacity available to the persistent volume该 PersistentVolume 可用的存储容量
  • The read/write access modes applicable to the persistent volume适用于该 PersistentVolume 的读写访问模式

When you inspect the created PersistentVolume, you’ll find most of the information you provided in the manifest. The status Available indicates that the object is ready to be claimed. The reclaim policy determines what should happen with the PersistentVolume after it has been released from its claim. By default, the object will be retained. The following example uses the short-form command pv to avoid having to type persistentvolume:

当你查看创建好的 PersistentVolume 时，会看到你在清单中提供的大部分信息。状态 Available 表示该对象已准备好被声明。回收策略决定了 PersistentVolume 从其 claim 释放后应该如何处理。默认情况下，该对象会被保留。下面的例子使用简写命令 pv，避免每次都敲 persistentvolume：

$ kubectl apply -f db-pv.yaml
persistentvolume/db-pv created
$ kubectl get pv db-pv
NAME    CAPACITY   ACCESS MODES   RECLAIM POLICY   STATUS    \
  CLAIM   STORAGECLASS   REASON   AGE
db-pv   1Gi        RWO            Retain           Available \
                                  10s

Configuration Options for a PersistentVolumePersistentVolume 的配置选项

A PersistentVolume offers a variety of configuration options that determine its innate runtime behavior. For the exam, it’s important to understand the volume mode, access mode, reclaim policy, and node affinity configuration options.

PersistentVolume 提供多种配置选项，决定其固有的运行时行为。备考时，理解 volume mode、access mode、reclaim policy 和 node affinity 这些配置选项非常重要。

Volume ModeVolume 模式

The volume mode handles the type of device. That’s a device either meant to be consumed from the filesystem or backed by a block device. The most common case is a filesystem device. You can set the volume mode using the attribute spec.volumeMode. Table 16-2 shows all available volume modes.

volume mode 处理设备的类型：设备要么通过文件系统消费，要么由块设备支撑。最常见的情况是文件系统设备。你可以通过 spec.volumeMode 属性设置 volume mode。表 16-2 列出了所有可用的 volume mode。

— PDF p.228 —
TypeDescription
FilesystemDefault. Mounts the volume into a directory of the consuming Pod. Creates a filesystem first if the volume is backed by a block device and the device is empty.
Filesystem默认值。把 volume 挂载到使用它的 Pod 的某个目录中。如果 volume 由块设备支撑且设备为空，会先创建文件系统。
BlockUsed for a volume as a raw block device without a filesystem on it.
Block把 volume 当作原始块设备使用，其上没有文件系统。

The volume mode is not rendered by default in the console output of the get pv command. You will need to provide the -o wide command-line option to see the VOLUMEMODE column, as shown here:

volume mode 默认不会显示在 get pv 命令的控制台输出中。你需要加 -o wide 命令行选项才能看到 VOLUMEMODE 列，如下所示：

$ kubectl get pv -o wide
NAME    CAPACITY   ACCESS MODES   RECLAIM POLICY   STATUS    \
CLAIM   STORAGECLASS   REASON   AGE   VOLUMEMODE
db-pv   1Gi        RWO            Retain           Available \
                                    19m   Filesystem

Access Mode访问模式

Each PersistentVolume can express how it can be accessed using the attribute spec.accessModes. For example, you can define that the volume can be mounted only by a single Pod in a read or write mode or that a volume is read-only but accessible from different nodes simultaneously. Table 16-3 provides an overview of the available access modes. The short-form notation of the access mode is usually rendered in outputs of specific commands, e.g., get pv or describe pv.

每个 PersistentVolume 都可以通过 spec.accessModes 属性表达它可被访问的方式。例如，你可以定义 volume 只能被单个 Pod 以读写模式挂载，或者 volume 是只读的但可同时被不同节点访问。表 16-3 概述了可用的访问模式。访问模式的简写通常会显示在 get pv、describe pv 等命令的输出中。

TypeShort formDescription
ReadWriteOnceRWORead/write access by a single node
ReadWriteOnceRWO单节点读写访问
ReadOnlyManyROXRead-only access by many nodes
ReadOnlyManyROX多节点只读访问
ReadWriteManyRWXRead/write access by many nodes
ReadWriteManyRWX多节点读写访问
ReadWriteOncePodRWOPRead/write access mounted by a single Pod
ReadWriteOncePodRWOP单个 Pod 挂载的读写访问

The following command parses the access modes from the PersistentVolume named db-pv. As you can see, the returned value is an array underlining the fact that you can assign multiple access modes at once:

下面的命令解析名为 db-pv 的 PersistentVolume 的访问模式。如你所见，返回值是一个数组，这说明你可以一次指定多个访问模式：

$ kubectl get pv db-pv -o jsonpath='{.spec.accessModes}'
["ReadWriteOnce"]

ReadWriteOnce (RWO) allows mounting by a single node as read-write, ideal for databases like MySQL or PostgreSQL and stateful applications using block storage (AWS EBS, GCE Persistent Disk).

ReadWriteOnce（RWO）允许单个节点以读写方式挂载，非常适合 MySQL、PostgreSQL 等数据库，以及使用块存储（AWS EBS、GCE Persistent Disk）的有状态应用。

— PDF p.229 —

ReadOnlyMany (ROX) enables multiple nodes to mount read-only simultaneously, perfect for serving static web content or shared configuration files across multiple Pods. ReadWriteMany (RWX) permits concurrent read-write access from multiple nodes, requiring file-based storage like NFS or AWS EFS, is essential for shared upload directories or content management systems where multiple Pods process the same files. ReadWriteOncePod (RWOP) ensures only one Pod cluster-wide can mount the volume, providing stronger guarantees than RWO for applications like etcd or during StatefulSet migrations where absolute single-writer semantics are critical. Storage provider support varies: block storage typically supports RWO/RWOP while file systems are needed for ROX/RWX.

ReadOnlyMany（ROX）允许多个节点同时只读挂载，非常适合为多个 Pod 提供静态 Web 内容或共享配置文件。ReadWriteMany（RWX）允许多个节点并发读写访问，需要 NFS 或 AWS EFS 之类的文件存储，对于多 Pod 处理同一文件的共享上传目录或内容管理系统至关重要。ReadWriteOncePod（RWOP）确保全集群只有一个 Pod 能挂载该 volume，为 etcd 这类应用或 StatefulSet 迁移（要求绝对单写者语义）提供比 RWO 更强的保证。存储厂商的支持各不相同：块存储通常支持 RWO/RWOP，而 ROX/RWX 需要文件系统。

Reclaim Policy回收策略

Optionally, you can also define a reclaim policy for a PersistentVolume. The reclaim policy specifies what should happen to a PersistentVolume object when the bound PersistentVolumeClaim is deleted (see Table 16-4). For dynamically created PersistentVolumes, the reclaim policy can be set via the attribute .reclaimPolicy in the storage class. For statically created PersistentVolumes, use the attribute spec.persistentVolumeReclaimPolicy in the PersistentVolume definition.

你还可以选择性地为 PersistentVolume 定义回收策略。回收策略指定：当绑定的 PersistentVolumeClaim 被删除时，PersistentVolume 对象应该如何处理（见表 16-4）。对于动态创建的 PersistentVolume，可以在 StorageClass 中通过 .reclaimPolicy 属性设置回收策略。对于静态创建的 PersistentVolume，则在 PersistentVolume 定义中使用 spec.persistentVolumeReclaimPolicy 属性。

TypeDescription
RetainDefault. When PersistentVolumeClaim is deleted, the PersistentVolume is “released” and must be manually reclaimed.
Retain默认值。当 PersistentVolumeClaim 被删除时，PersistentVolume 进入“released”状态，必须手动回收。
DeleteDeletion removes PersistentVolume and its associated storage.
Delete删除时会同时移除 PersistentVolume 及其关联的存储。
RecycleThis value is deprecated. You should use one of the other values.
Recycle该值已被弃用。你应使用其他值之一。

This command retrieves the assigned reclaim policy of the PersistentVolume named db-pv:

下面的命令获取名为 db-pv 的 PersistentVolume 所分配的回收策略：

$ kubectl get pv db-pv -o jsonpath='{.spec.persistentVolumeReclaimPolicy}'
Retain

Node Affinity节点亲和性

Node affinity allows you to constrain which nodes a PersistentVolume can be accessed from. This is particularly important for local storage types like local and hostPath volumes, which are physically tied to specific nodes. By defining node affinity rules, you ensure that Pods using the PersistentVolume are scheduled only on nodes that can actually access the underlying storage.

节点亲和性让你可以限制 PersistentVolume 可从哪些节点访问。这对于 local、hostPath 等本地存储类型尤其重要，因为它们物理上绑定到特定节点。通过定义节点亲和性规则，你可以确保使用该 PersistentVolume 的 Pod 只会被调度到真正能访问底层存储的节点上。

The node affinity is specified using the spec.nodeAffinity field in the PersistentVolume definition. It uses the same syntax as Pod node affinity, with required rules that must be satisfied for the volume to be accessible.

节点亲和性在 PersistentVolume 定义中通过 spec.nodeAffinity 字段指定。它使用与 Pod 节点亲和性相同的语法，其中 required 规则必须满足，volume 才可访问。

— PDF p.230 —

Example 16-2 illustrates an example of a PersistentVolume with node affinity that restricts it to specific nodes.

例 16-2 展示了一个带节点亲和性的 PersistentVolume 示例，把它限制到特定节点。

Example 16-2. Defining node affinity for a PersistentVolume

例 16-2. 为 PersistentVolume 定义节点亲和性

apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolume
metadata:
  name: local-pv
spec:
  capacity:
    storage: 10Gi
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  persistentVolumeReclaimPolicy: Retain
  storageClassName: local-storage
  local:
    path: /mnt/data
  nodeAffinity:
    required:
      nodeSelectorTerms:
      - matchExpressions:
        - key: kubernetes.io/hostname
          operator: In
          values:
          - node01
          - node02
  • Uses the local volume type, which requires node affinity使用 local volume 类型，该类型要求节点亲和性
  • Defines node affinity rules for this PersistentVolume为该 PersistentVolume 定义节点亲和性规则
  • Restricts the volume to nodes with hostnames node01 or node02把该 volume 限制到主机名为 node01 或 node02 的节点

Common use cases for node affinity with PersistentVolumes include:

PersistentVolume 节点亲和性的常见用例包括：

  • Local volumes: Must specify node affinity to indicate which node contains the storage本地 volume：必须指定节点亲和性，指明哪个节点上包含该存储
  • Zone constraints: Ensuring volumes are accessed only from nodes in specific availability zones可用区约束：确保 volume 只能从特定可用区的节点访问
  • Hardware requirements: Restricting volumes to nodes with specific storage hardware (e.g., SSD nodes)硬件要求：把 volume 限制到具备特定存储硬件的节点（例如 SSD 节点）

When a PersistentVolumeClaim binds to a PersistentVolume with node affinity, any Pod using that claim will be scheduled according to these constraints. If no suitable node is available, the Pod will remain in Pending status.

当 PersistentVolumeClaim 绑定到带节点亲和性的 PersistentVolume 时，任何使用该 claim 的 Pod 都会按这些约束被调度。如果没有合适的节点可用，Pod 将一直处于 Pending 状态。

— PDF p.231 —

Important considerations:

重要注意事项：

  • Node affinity is required for local volume types.local 类型的 volume 必须配置节点亲和性。
  • The scheduler considers both the Pod’s node selectors and the PersistentVolume’s node affinity.调度器会同时考虑 Pod 的 nodeSelector 和 PersistentVolume 的节点亲和性。
  • Changes to node labels after binding don’t affect existing mounted volumes.绑定之后再修改节点 label，不会影响已经挂载的 volume。
  • For high availability, avoid overly restrictive node affinity rules.为了高可用，应避免使用过于严格的节点亲和性规则。

Creating PersistentVolumeClaims创建 PersistentVolumeClaim

The next object we’ll need to create is the PersistentVolumeClaim. Its purpose is to bind the PersistentVolume to the Pod. Let’s look at the YAML manifest stored in the file db-pvc.yaml, shown in Example 16-3.

接下来我们需要创建的对象是 PersistentVolumeClaim。它的作用是把 PersistentVolume 绑定到 Pod。我们看一下保存在文件 db-pvc.yaml 中的 YAML 清单，如例 16-3 所示。

Example 16-3. Definition of a PersistentVolumeClaim

例 16-3. PersistentVolumeClaim 的定义

kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
apiVersion: v1
metadata:
  name: db-pvc
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  storageClassName: ""
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 256Mi
  • The access modes we’re asking an unbound persistent volume to provide我们要求一个未绑定的 PersistentVolume 提供的访问模式
  • Uses an empty string assignment to indicate that we want to use static provisioning用空字符串赋值表示我们要使用静态供应
  • The minimum amount of storage an unbound persistent volume needs to have available一个未绑定的 PersistentVolume 至少需要提供的存储量

What that’s saying is: “Give me a PersistentVolume that can fulfill the resource request of 256 Mi and provides the access mode ReadWriteOnce.”

它表达的意思是：“给我一个能满足 256 Mi 资源请求、并提供 ReadWriteOnce 访问模式的 PersistentVolume。”

Static provisioning should use an empty string for the attribute spec.storageClassName if you do not want it to automatically assign the default storage class. The binding to an appropriate PersistentVolume happens automatically based on those criteria.

如果不想自动使用默认 StorageClass，静态供应时应把 spec.storageClassName 设为空字符串。是否能绑定到合适的 PersistentVolume，会根据这些条件自动完成。

— PDF p.232 —

After creating the PersistentVolumeClaim, the status is set as Bound, which means that the binding to the PersistentVolume was successful. Once the associated binding occurs, nothing else can bind to it. The binding relationship is one-to-one. Nothing else can bind to the PersistentVolume once claimed. The following get command uses the short-form pvc instead of persistentvolumeclaim:

创建 PersistentVolumeClaim 后，状态会变为 Bound，表示与 PersistentVolume 的绑定成功。一旦发生绑定，其他任何对象都不能再绑定到它。绑定关系是一对一的。PersistentVolume 一旦被声明，就不能再被其他对象绑定。下面的 get 命令使用简写 pvc 代替 persistentvolumeclaim：

$ kubectl apply -f db-pvc.yaml
persistentvolumeclaim/db-pvc created
$ kubectl get pvc db-pvc
NAME     STATUS   VOLUME   CAPACITY   ACCESS MODES   STORAGECLASS   AGE
db-pvc   Bound    db-pv    1Gi        RWO                           111s

The PersistentVolume has not been mounted by a Pod yet. Therefore, inspecting the details of the object shows <none>. Using the describe command is a good way to verify that the PersistentVolumeClaim was mounted properly:

此时 PersistentVolume 还没有被任何 Pod 挂载。因此查看对象详情时会显示 <none>。使用 describe 命令是验证 PersistentVolumeClaim 是否正确挂载的好方法：

$ kubectl describe pvc db-pvc
...
Used By:       <none>
...

Binding by Volume Name按 volume 名称绑定

When creating a PersistentVolumeClaim, you can optionally specify the exact PersistentVolume you want to bind to using the spec.volumeName attribute. This creates a direct binding between the PersistentVolumeClaim and a specific PersistentVolume, bypassing the normal matching algorithm that considers storage size, access modes, and storage class.

创建 PersistentVolumeClaim 时，你可以选择通过 spec.volumeName 属性指定要绑定的具体 PersistentVolume。这会在 PersistentVolumeClaim 与特定 PersistentVolume 之间建立直接绑定，绕过综合考虑存储大小、访问模式和 StorageClass 的常规匹配算法。

This is useful in scenarios where:

这在以下场景中很有用：

  • You have preprovisioned PersistentVolumes with specific characteristics.你已经预配了具有特定特性的 PersistentVolume。
  • You need to ensure that a PersistentVolumeClaim binds to a particular PersistentVolume for compliance or data locality reasons.出于合规或数据本地性的原因，需要确保 PersistentVolumeClaim 绑定到特定的 PersistentVolume。
  • You want to reuse an existing PersistentVolume that contains important data.你想复用一个包含重要数据的已有 PersistentVolume。

Example 16-4 shows an example of a PersistentVolumeClaim that explicitly binds to a PersistentVolume named db-pv.

例 16-4 展示了一个显式绑定到名为 db-pv 的 PersistentVolume 的 PersistentVolumeClaim 示例。

Example 16-4. Binding a PersistentVolume to a PersistentVolumeClaim by name

例 16-4. 按名称把 PersistentVolume 绑定到 PersistentVolumeClaim

apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: specific-pvc
spec:
  volumeName: db-pv
— PDF p.233 —
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
  • Explicitly binds this PersistentVolumeClaim to the PersistentVolume named db-pv.把这个 PersistentVolumeClaim 显式绑定到名为 db-pv 的 PersistentVolume。

When using volumeName, ensure that:

使用 volumeName 时，请确保：

  • The specified PersistentVolume exists and is in Available status.指定的 PersistentVolume 存在且处于 Available 状态。
  • The PersistentVolume’s capacity is greater than or equal to the PersistentVolumeClaim’s requested storage.PersistentVolume 的容量大于或等于 PersistentVolumeClaim 请求的存储量。
  • The access modes are compatible.访问模式兼容。
  • The storage classes match (or both are unset).StorageClass 匹配（或两者都未设置）。

If these conditions aren’t met, the PersistentVolumeClaim will remain in Pending status.

如果这些条件不满足，PersistentVolumeClaim 将一直处于 Pending 状态。

Mounting PersistentVolumeClaims in a Pod在 Pod 中挂载 PersistentVolumeClaim

All that’s left is to mount the PersistentVolumeClaim in the Pod that wants to consume it. You already learned how to mount a volume in a Pod. The big difference here, shown in Example 16-5, is using spec.volumes[].persistentVolumeClaim and providing the name of the PersistentVolumeClaim.

剩下的就是在要使用该 PersistentVolumeClaim 的 Pod 中挂载它。你已经学过如何在 Pod 中挂载 volume。这里的主要区别如例 16-5 所示：使用 spec.volumes[].persistentVolumeClaim 并提供 PersistentVolumeClaim 的名称。

Example 16-5. A Pod referencing a PersistentVolumeClaim

例 16-5. 一个引用 PersistentVolumeClaim 的 Pod

apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: app-consuming-pvc
spec:
  volumes:
  - name: app-storage
    persistentVolumeClaim:
      claimName: db-pvc
  containers:
  - image: alpine:3.22.2
    name: app
    command: ["/bin/sh"]
    args: ["-c", "while true; do sleep 60; done;"]
    volumeMounts:
      - mountPath: "/mnt/data"
        name: app-storage
— PDF p.234 —
  • The volume type that selects a persistent volume claim by name按名称选择 PersistentVolumeClaim 的 volume 类型
  • The name of the persistent volume claim object we want to bind to我们想绑定到的 PersistentVolumeClaim 对象的名称

Let’s assume we stored the configuration in the file app-consuming-pvc.yaml. After creating the Pod from the manifest, you should see the Pod transitioning into the Ready state. The describe command will provide additional information on the volume:

假设我们把配置保存到文件 app-consuming-pvc.yaml。用清单创建 Pod 后，你应该看到 Pod 进入 Ready 状态。describe 命令会提供关于该 volume 的更多信息：

$ kubectl apply -f app-consuming-pvc.yaml
pod/app-consuming-pvc created
$ kubectl get pods
NAME                READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
app-consuming-pvc   1/1     Running   0          3s
$ kubectl describe pod app-consuming-pvc
...
Volumes:
  app-storage:
    Type:       PersistentVolumeClaim (a reference to a PersistentVolumeClaim \
                in the same namespace)
    ClaimName:  db-pvc
    ReadOnly:   false
...

The PersistentVolumeClaim now also shows the Pod that mounted it:

此时 PersistentVolumeClaim 也会显示挂载它的 Pod：

$ kubectl describe pvc db-pvc
...
Used By:       app-consuming-pvc
...

You can now go ahead and open an interactive shell to the Pod. Navigating to the mount path at /mnt/data gives you access to the underlying PersistentVolume:

现在你可以打开 Pod 的交互式 shell。进入挂载路径 /mnt/data，就能访问底层的 PersistentVolume：

$ kubectl exec app-consuming-pvc -it -- /bin/sh
/ # cd /mnt/data
/mnt/data # ls -l
total 0
/mnt/data # touch test.db
/mnt/data # ls -l
total 0
-rw-r--r--    1 root     root             0 Sep 29 23:59 test.db

Storage ClassesStorageClass

A StorageClass is a Kubernetes primitive that defines a specific type or “class” of storage. One typical storage characteristic is the type (e.g., fast SSD storage versus remote cloud storage or the backup policy for storage). The storage class is used to provision a PersistentVolume dynamically based on its criteria.

StorageClass 是一个 Kubernetes 原语，定义了特定类型或“类别”的存储。一个典型的存储特性是类型（例如快速 SSD 存储 vs 远程云存储，或存储的备份策略）。StorageClass 用于根据其标准动态供应 PersistentVolume。

— PDF p.235 —

In practice, this means that you do not have to create the PersistentVolume object yourself. The provisioner assigned to the storage class takes care of it. Most Kubernetes cloud providers come with a list of existing provisioners. minikube already creates a default storage class named standard, which you can query with the following command:

实际使用时，这意味着你不需要自己创建 PersistentVolume 对象。分配给 StorageClass 的供应者会负责这件事。大多数 Kubernetes 云厂商都自带一份现成的供应者清单。minikube 已经创建了一个名为 standard 的默认 StorageClass，你可以用下面的命令查询：

$ kubectl get storageclass
NAME                 PROVISIONER                RECLAIMPOLICY \
  VOLUMEBINDINGMODE   ALLOWVOLUMEEXPANSION   AGE
standard (default)   k8s.io/minikube-hostpath   Delete        \
  Immediate           false                  108d

Creating Storage Classes创建 StorageClass

Storage classes can be created declaratively only with the help of a YAML manifest. At a minimum, you need to declare the provisioner. All other attributes are optional and use default values if not provided upon creation. Most provisioners let you set parameters specific to the storage type. Example 16-6 defines a storage class on Google Compute Engine denoted by the provisioner kubernetes.io/gce-pd.

StorageClass 只能通过 YAML 清单以声明式方式创建。至少需要声明供应者（provisioner）。其他所有属性都是可选的，如果创建时未提供则使用默认值。大多数供应者允许你设置与存储类型相关的参数。例 16-6 在 Google Compute Engine 上定义了一个 StorageClass，其供应者为 kubernetes.io/gce-pd。

Example 16-6. Definition of a storage class

例 16-6. 一个 StorageClass 的定义

apiVersion: storage.k8s.io/v1
kind: StorageClass
metadata:
  name: fast
provisioner: kubernetes.io/gce-pd
parameters:
  type: pd-ssd
  replication-type: regional-pd

If you saved the YAML contents in the file fast-sc.yaml, then the following command will create the object. The storage class can be listed using the get storageclass command:

如果你把 YAML 内容保存到文件 fast-sc.yaml，下面的命令就会创建该对象。可以用 get storageclass 命令列出 StorageClass：

$ kubectl create -f fast-sc.yaml
storageclass.storage.k8s.io/fast created
$ kubectl get storageclass
NAME                 PROVISIONER                RECLAIMPOLICY \
  VOLUMEBINDINGMODE   ALLOWVOLUMEEXPANSION   AGE
fast                 kubernetes.io/gce-pd       Delete        \
  Immediate           false                  4s
...
— PDF p.236 —

Using Storage Classes使用 StorageClass

Provisioning a PersistentVolume dynamically requires assigning of the storage class when you create the PersistentVolumeClaim. Example 16-7 shows the usage of the attribute spec.storageClassName for assigning the storage class named standard.

动态供应 PersistentVolume 时，需要在创建 PersistentVolumeClaim 时指定 StorageClass。例 16-7 展示了如何使用 spec.storageClassName 属性来指定名为 standard 的 StorageClass。

Example 16-7. Using a storage class in a PersistentVolumeClaim

例 16-7. 在 PersistentVolumeClaim 中使用 StorageClass

kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
apiVersion: v1
metadata:
  name: db-pvc
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 512Mi
  storageClassName: standard
  • Uses the storage class by its name to enable dynamic provisioning按名称使用 StorageClass，以启用动态供应

The corresponding PersistentVolume object will be created only if the storage class can provision a fitting PersistentVolume using its provisioner. It’s important to understand that Kubernetes does not render an error or warning message if this isn’t the case.

只有当 StorageClass 能用其供应者供应出一个合适的 PersistentVolume 时，对应的 PersistentVolume 对象才会被创建。需要理解的是：如果供应失败，Kubernetes 并不会报错或给出警告。

The following command renders the created PersistentVolumeClaim and PersistentVolume. As you can see, the name of the dynamically provisioned PersistentVolume uses a hash to ensure a unique naming:

下面的命令显示创建好的 PersistentVolumeClaim 和 PersistentVolume。如你所见，动态供应的 PersistentVolume 名称使用了一段哈希以保证命名唯一：

$ kubectl get pv,pvc
NAME                                                       CAPACITY \
  ACCESS MODES  RECLAIM POLICY  STATUS  CLAIM           STORAGECLASS \
  REASON  AGE
persistentvolume/pvc-b820b919-f7f7-4c74-9212-ef259d421734   512Mi \
    RWO           Delete          Bound   default/db-pvc  standard \
                  2s

NAME                          STATUS  VOLUME                                  \
CAPACITY  ACCESS MODES  STORAGECLASS  AGE
persistentvolumeclaim/db-pvc  Bound   pvc-b820b919-f7f7-4c74-9212-ef259d421734 \
512Mi     RWO           standard      2s

The steps for mounting the PersistentVolumeClaim from a Pod are the same as for static and dynamic provisioning. Refer to “Mounting PersistentVolumeClaims in a Pod” on page 212 for more information.

在 Pod 中挂载 PersistentVolumeClaim 的步骤，在静态供应和动态供应下是一样的。更多信息见第 212 页“Mounting PersistentVolumeClaims in a Pod”。

— PDF p.237 —

Summary本章小结

PersistentVolumes store data beyond a Pod or cluster/node restart. Those objects are decoupled from the Pod’s lifecycle and are therefore represented by a Kubernetes primitive. The PersistentVolumeClaim abstracts the underlying implementation details of a PersistentVolume and acts as an intermediary between the Pod and PersistentVolume. A PersistentVolume can be provisioned statically by creating the object or dynamically with the help of a provisioner assigned to a storage class.

PersistentVolume 在 Pod 或集群/节点重启后仍然存储数据。这些对象与 Pod 的生命周期解耦，因此由一个 Kubernetes 原语来表示。PersistentVolumeClaim 把 PersistentVolume 的底层实现细节抽象出来，充当 Pod 与 PersistentVolume 之间的中介。PersistentVolume 可以通过手动创建对象来静态供应，也可以借助分配给 StorageClass 的供应者来动态供应。

Exam Essentials考试要点

Internalize the mechanics of defining and consuming a PersistentVolume内化定义与使用 PersistentVolume 的机制

Creating a PersistentVolume involves a couple of moving parts. Understand the configuration options for PersistentVolumes and PersistentVolumeClaims and how they play together. Try to emulate situations that prevent a successful binding of a PersistentVolumeClaim. Then fix the situation by taking counteractions. Internalize the short-form commands pv and pvc to save precious time during the exam.

创建 PersistentVolume 涉及多个联动部分。要理解 PersistentVolume 和 PersistentVolumeClaim 的配置选项以及它们如何配合。尝试模拟导致 PersistentVolumeClaim 无法成功绑定的场景，然后通过反向操作修复它。牢记简写命令 pv 和 pvc，以在考试中节省宝贵时间。

Know the differences between static and dynamic provisioning of a PersistentVolume区分 PersistentVolume 的静态供应与动态供应

A PersistentVolume must be created statically by creating the object from a YAML manifest. Alternatively, you can let Kubernetes provision a PersistentVolume dynamically without your direct involvement. For this to happen, assign a storage class to the PersistentVolumeClaim. The provisioner of the storage class takes care of creating the PersistentVolume object for you.

静态供应 PersistentVolume 必须通过 YAML 清单创建对象。或者，你可以让 Kubernetes 在你不直接参与的情况下动态供应 PersistentVolume。要做到这一点，为 PersistentVolumeClaim 指定一个 StorageClass，StorageClass 的供应者会替你创建 PersistentVolume 对象。

Sample Exercises样题练习

Solutions to these exercises are available in Appendix A.

这些练习的解答见附录 A。

  1. Create a PersistentVolume named logs-pv that maps to the hostPath /var/logs. The access mode should be ReadWriteOnce and ReadOnlyMany. Provision a storage capacity of 5 Gi. Ensure that the status of the PersistentVolume shows Available. Create a PersistentVolumeClaim named logs-pvc. It uses ReadWriteOnce access. Request a capacity of 2 Gi. Ensure that the status of the PersistentVolume shows Bound. Mount the PersistentVolumeClaim in a Pod running the image nginx at the mount path /var/log/nginx. Open an interactive shell to the container and create a new file named my-nginx.log in /var/log/nginx. Exit out of the Pod.创建一个名为 logs-pv 的 PersistentVolume，映射到 hostPath /var/logs。访问模式为 ReadWriteOnce 和 ReadOnlyMany。供应 5 Gi 存储容量。确保 PersistentVolume 状态为 Available。创建一个名为 logs-pvc 的 PersistentVolumeClaim，使用 ReadWriteOnce 访问模式，请求 2 Gi 容量。确保 PersistentVolume 状态为 Bound。在一个运行 nginx 镜像的 Pod 中，把该 PersistentVolumeClaim 挂载到 /var/log/nginx。打开容器的交互式 shell，在 /var/log/nginx 中创建名为 my-nginx.log 的新文件。退出 Pod。
— PDF p.238 —
  1. Delete the Pod and re-create it with the same YAML manifest. Open an interactive shell to the Pod, navigate to the directory /var/log/nginx, and find the file you created before.删除该 Pod 并用同一份 YAML 清单重新创建。打开 Pod 的交互式 shell，进入目录 /var/log/nginx，找到你之前创建的文件。
  2. Navigate to the directory app-a/ch16/dynamic-provisioning of the checked-out GitHub repository bmuschko/cka-study-guide. Inspect the YAML manifest definition in the file local-path-storage-0.0.31.yaml. Create the objects from the YAML manifest file. Create a PersistentVolumeClaim named db-pvc in the namespace persistence. The access it uses is ReadWriteOnce. Request a capacity of 10 Mi. Use the storage class name local-path. Ensure that the status of the PersistentVolumeClaim object shows Pending. A PersistentVolume object should not have been provisioned yet. Mount the PersistentVolumeClaim in a Pod named app-consuming-pvc in the namespace persistence at the mount path /mnt/data. The container should use the image alpine:3.21.3. Wait until the Pod transitions into the Running status. Ensure that the PersistentVolume object has been created dynamically. Open an interactive shell to the container, and create a new file named test.db in /mnt/data. Exit out of the Pod.进入已克隆的 GitHub 仓库 bmuschko/cka-study-guide 的目录 app-a/ch16/dynamic-provisioning。查看文件 local-path-storage-0.0.31.yaml 中的 YAML 清单定义。根据该清单创建对象。在 namespace persistence 中创建一个名为 db-pvc 的 PersistentVolumeClaim。使用 ReadWriteOnce 访问模式，请求 10 Mi 容量，StorageClass 名称为 local-path。确保 PersistentVolumeClaim 对象状态为 Pending，此时还不应供应出 PersistentVolume 对象。在 namespace persistence 中创建名为 app-consuming-pvc 的 Pod，把该 PersistentVolumeClaim 挂载到 /mnt/data，容器使用镜像 alpine:3.21.3。等待 Pod 进入 Running 状态，确认 PersistentVolume 对象已被动态创建。打开容器的交互式 shell，在 /mnt/data 中创建名为 test.db 的新文件。退出 Pod。
— PDF p.239 —
